notes.title: The inspiration behind the map!
notes.content:
Hello Constructors!

Are you curious what region inspired this map?

[previewyoutube=Kit9YCoWiXY;full][/previewyoutube]
What place is surrounded by mountains and has this kind of architecture?
Any ideas?

We won’t keep you in the dark any longer.
This map was inspired by a village in north-western Slovenia.

What do you think about this map?
Let us know!

And if you have any questions or simply want to stay up to date - join our Discord and become a part of Madnetic Games Community family

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/bd6668c45a94a501fab5b0f3b15cdb066b1598f8.png

notes.title: The town is growing!
notes.content:
Hello Constructors!

It’s time for another update!
You’ve already seen a few vehicles that you’ll get to use throughout the game. But to be able to drive them, you need roads. To make them work, you need buildings. In short - you need a town.

And we have good news. We’re already building it!

Here, take a look at this beautiful house

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/e0fbb3057ce6b4f2708a9231a2cdd81fd9008cf7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/9c168ca76af54d94bcaa109f953bd43f6dbe2085.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/606c0d3c9d0c53e648f8048292e82bd5add2747b.png

Isn’t it great? Let us know what you think!

Stay tuned for more! You can do that by joining our Discord. Become a part of Madnetic Games Community family

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/bd6668c45a94a501fab5b0f3b15cdb066b1598f8.png

notes.title: Reach higher with the static crane!
notes.content:
Hello Constructors!

It's time for another update on Heavy Duty Costruction.
This time instead of driving left and right, we will go up.

We present to you the static crane!

This machine will help you with bigger constructions requiring reaching higher than the mobile crane allows you to and lifting even heavier objects.

notes.title: This crane will lift your spirits!
notes.content:
Hello Constructors!

Thursday became our unofficial Progress Sharing Day - so we’re back to present to you another vehicle.

With the excavator and the dump truck you can already dig and load different materials to move them from one place to another. But working on a construction site requires heavy lifting as well.

This brand new mobile crane will come in handy!

notes.title: These vehicles are ready to work!
notes.content:

You’re already familiar with the excavator and the dump truck, but did you know that those vehicles are not only able to move now but also to cooperate?

We’ve done some testing and they’re getting along pretty well.

notes.title: Heavy Duty Construction takeover
notes.content:
Hi Constructors!

Madnetic Games Team here!

We wanted to officially announce that
Madnetic Games takes over Heavy Duty Construction

It’s exciting for us to take this project under our wing! To mark this new chapter we decided to
change the game’s logo a bit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/8a55437e186e469f29c03c25ed699a6d51e3d77b.png

and open a new channel on our Discord!
So if you want to stay up to date make sure to join us and become a part of Madnetic Games Community family
